title: "Catalyst project on polarimetric radar for New Zealand glaciers"
date: 2025-01-01   # TODO: exact start date (the CVs give only the year)
description: "A Royal Society Te Apārangi Catalyst project begins, using RADARSAT Constellation Mission data to track end-of-summer snowlines in the New Zealand Alps."
categories: [grant]
---

A Royal Society Te Apārangi Catalyst project started in 2025. It uses high-resolution
polarimetric radar images from the RADARSAT Constellation Mission to assess the
end-of-summer snowline on glaciers in the New Zealand Alps. See the
[project page](../projects/rcm-glaciers.qmd).
